title: 桜花賞の後に・私だけのドゥリーム

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Amazing! I can't believe how good that felt! It really seems like mile races are the best distance for me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Should I set the 1,600-meter NHK Mile Championship as my next goal? Is it really okay to give up the 2,400-meter Japanese Oaks? Isn't the grandest European G1 race 2,400 meters long?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …No, I shouldn't try and run 2,400 meters. My biggest goal is to win a European G1. I want to show the world courage, not recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In order to maximize my possibilities, I'm going to take on the world one mile at a time! The best match for me is the NHK Mile Championship, and that's what I'll be running next!
